purpose: Full-width sound section: natural front-facing woman with eyes closed, life-size floating earbuds and subtle waves
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Create a new wide 2.4:1 transparent-background photograph for an audio website. The user wants an ORDINARY, NORMAL WOMAN, not a beauty model or an AI-fashion portrait. It should feel like a real, lightly retouched candid portrait taken with a good camera.

Composition: exactly one adult woman in her 30s shown from upper chest upward, perfectly front-facing, looking straight ahead with BOTH EYES GENTLY CLOSED. The camera is exactly at eye level. Her CHIN IS LEVEL, not lifted, head not tilted backward or to either side. Relaxed neutral mouth, lips naturally closed, ordinary calm expression. Normal facial proportions and small natural asymmetries, visible authentic skin pores and a few subtle everyday imperfections. No glossy skin, glamour makeup, plumped lips, false lashes, fashion styling or idealized symmetry. Natural medium-brown hair simply tied back, both ears visible, a plain everyday black crew-neck T-shirt. Soft natural window-like daylight on the face, realistic neutral skin tones, low-key non-dramatic lighting. Keep complete head and shoulders in frame. Normal woman with eyes closed, no performative ecstasy or meditation pose.

Earbuds: exactly TWO of the referenced CYMBA One earbuds floating just outside her ears, ONE each side, NOT inserted. They must be TRUE LIFE SIZE: the entire earbud including its wing is only about 25–30 mm tall, approximately ONE EIGHTH of her head height from chin to crown. Each should be roughly the size of the visible human outer ear or a little smaller, NEVER larger than her ear. They are tiny accessories in this portrait, not huge product closeups. About 25–35 mm of visible air separates each silicone tip from its corresponding ear. Tips face inward. Preserve the graphite circular brushed-metal faceplate, fine champagne rim, curved black wing with two contact pads, smoke-gray silicone tip and fine black braided cable from the two product reference images. These images provide PRODUCT DESIGN ONLY, absolutely not the product's scale in the scene. Thin cables hang naturally down outside the shoulders.

Sound waves: only TWO fine understated pale-gray curved lines on each side, connecting each bud's tip toward its adjacent ear across that short gap. Very thin and subtle, low opacity. No bright points at the ears, no glow, no particles, no luminous ribbons, no gold beams, no rings surrounding her head, no ripples elsewhere. Simple quiet graphic strokes that are barely visible on a black website.

Background: entirely genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha, including all space around the woman's head and shoulders and between the earbuds. Absolutely NO light background or halo behind the head, no glow, no grey blob, no rectangle, no scenery, no fake checkerboard. The woman and earbuds are fully opaque, just the wave lines partially transparent. Clean natural hair edges. Clothing at bottom softly fades into transparency so it blends onto a black page.

Image proportions: wide horizontal 2.4:1 with the woman centered. Her head occupies about 65% of canvas height and 20–25% of canvas width. The life-size earbuds sit close to the ears within the central half of the composition. Generous completely transparent space on the far left and right. This is an honest human portrait with a subtle audio concept, not a sci-fi ad, luxury cosmetics shoot or synthetic 3D render. No text or watermark.
